Limitations: Scope is the attached workbook against the current complete canonical Test Solution package, not all bank/host behavior.
Candidate mappings reuse the repository's explicit TEMPLATE_MAP and add documented current expiry/representation candidates; matching IDs are not semantic approval.
RULE_ALIGNED means the reviewed clause has a supporting rule, not that its scenario or expected business result passed.
Canonical selector is run in memory without normalizing or rewriting producer artifacts; it checks graph/anchors, not behavioral completeness.
EXECUTABLE is a producer readiness label; no Java harness test, wire transaction or host assertion passed in this review.
No new missing scenarios, BRs, payloads or approval decisions were inserted into training truth.
A missing direct mapping is not proof that no related concept occurs anywhere in the repository.
Expiry authorization transmission rule must not be generalized to issuer eligibility decisions for every purchase.

scenarios.Acceptance criteria: System shall accept valid Mastercard credit card numbers only
scenarios.Existing map caveat: PAN presence covered; Luhn only for payment tokens; no Mastercard BIN-range or card-status BR.
Clause findings: Account presence rule exists; the generic positive fixture is not a Mastercard-specific purchase.
Token numeric/length rules exist; no mapped generic Mastercard PAN numeric mutation pair.
Token BIN designation is not a verified current Mastercard PAN IIN/BIN-range oracle.
Token length rules do not establish Mastercard PAN length eligibility.
Mapped Luhn rule is scoped to payment tokens, not all Mastercard PANs.
No direct active-card issuer-status assertion or host evidence in the mapped Test Solution.

scenarios.Acceptance criteria: System shall validate card expiration date
scenarios.Existing map caveat: Template cites Element 51; ATL105 carries card expiry in Element 12 (Card Discretionary Block Data). No 'not past current date' BR.
Clause findings: Element 51 is Mail Text Data. Use Element 12 Card Discretionary Block Data for manual card expiration.
New BR-SEG100-E12-MANUAL-EXPIRATION provides MMYY fixtures, including invalid month.
Four characters describe the expiration prefix; Element 12 as a whole may include additional application data.
ATL105 13.2 says merchants must send an expiration value even for expired cards on all authorizations. Separate transmission/format from issuer eligibility; do not universally reject here.

scenarios.Acceptance criteria: Card must be active and eligible for purchase
scenarios.Existing map caveat: No card blocked/lost/stolen/expired status BR (issuer-side behaviour).
Clause findings: Issuer blocked-card status needs an approved issuer fixture or simulator oracle.
Issuer lost/stolen-card status needs an approved issuer fixture or simulator oracle.
Expiry-based issuer eligibility is not the same as Element 12 transmission validation. Context and owner approval are needed.

scenarios.Acceptance criteria: System shall identify purchase transaction correctly
scenarios.Existing map caveat: Template 'Processing Code 020' corresponds to ATL105 Element 78 Prompt Code (transaction type 0 + card type).
Clause findings: ATL105 Element 78 combines transaction type 0 with a three-character financial card type. In current synthetic fixtures 0020 is purchase and 3020 is authorization; 020 alone must not be treated as the whole Prompt Code.

scenarios.Acceptance criteria: System shall validate card entry method
scenarios.Existing map caveat: Entry-method consistency and EMV Segment 130 covered; no allow-list BR for Swipe/Contactless/Manual/E-Commerce.
Clause findings: Entry-method consistency and the EMV Segment 130 companion rule exist; this list mixes entry/presence/channel dimensions and has no complete approved combination matrix.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: Terminal Identifier (Element 102) covered; no Merchant-active or MCC BR.
Clause findings: Mapped evidence validates Terminal Identifier Element 102 and components; this is not a standalone merchant-ID validation.
No mapped merchant-active eligibility oracle.
No mapped MCC-validity oracle.

scenarios.Acceptance criteria: ATL105 request must meet format requirements
scenarios.Existing map caveat: Template cites Element 55 = ATL105 Message Format Version Identifier.
Clause findings: Element 55 equals ATL105; positive/negative fixtures exist but retain REVIEW_REQUIRED readiness.
ATL105/ATL104 synthetic cases test the message-format identifier, not a release-version support policy.
One format field does not prove that every conditional/mandatory request element is populated.

scenarios.Acceptance criteria: Number of segments must match actual payload
Clause findings: Element 63 is Number of Segments; positive/negative fixture links exist.
Count equality rule and mismatched-count fixture exist; full wire/host acceptance has not run.
Segment 100 required exactly once is catalogued. Identity cases exist; placeholder presence evidence is not execution.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: Template cites Element 24; ATL105 Account Number is Element 2. No explicit numeric/no-delimiter/no-control-char BR.
Clause findings: Element 24 is Data Type Indicator, not Account Number. Use Element 2; add the account-presence BR as a candidate mapping.
Account representation depends on manual/track/token/TransArmor context; do not apply an unconditional numeric-only rule to all representations.
Delimiter and track-split rules must be assessed by representation, not as a universal assumption.
No mapped explicit control-character mutation/oracle for this clause.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: Only EMV authorized-amount cross-field agreement; no generic purchase-amount >0/currency/precision BR.
Clause findings: No mapped generic purchase >0 boundary rule; define eligible transaction contexts.
An EMV amount agreement rule is not a generic numeric-amount validation.
EMV currency/context agreement is represented, not universal currency-field presence.
No mapped explicit decimal-precision oracle and boundary cases for a generic purchase.
Canonical wording is net fuel amount when applicable, not an unqualified total fuel value. Linked conditional-fields TD has an empty standardSegment.
Canonical BR defines net nonfuel excluding cash/tax; numeric and >=0 boundaries are not concretely tested in the linked empty conditional-fields TD.
Total-tax rule exists; linked empty conditional-fields TD does not test numeric tax.
No concrete mapped tax-precision mutation/oracle.

scenarios.Acceptance criteria: Cash amount only allowed when applicable
Clause findings: Cash-amount rule exists; linked empty conditional-fields TD does not test numeric cash.
'business rules met' does not state permitted Mastercard credit contexts or expected rejection rules.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: Template cites Element 80; ATL105 Sequence Number is Element 86. Uniqueness not covered.
Clause findings: Element 80 is Purchase Code. Sequence Number is Element 86.
Six-digit sequence rule has a positive six-digit and negative five-digit fixture.
Length/lifecycle reuse do not prove uniqueness, allocation or concurrent-transaction collision behavior.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: Settlement retention not covered.
Clause findings: Follow-up sequence reuse is modelled. Settlement retention is not established; some linked lifecycle TD records have file references only, no inline payload.

scenarios.Acceptance criteria: Transaction identified as Mastercard Credit Purchase
scenarios.Existing map caveat: Card-type allow-list and credit classification exist; no BR that names the Mastercard card-type code.
Clause findings: Financial-card allow-list and receipt label do not establish end-to-end Mastercard routing/eligibility.
Nonproprietary credit classification BR exists; its data is metadata-only and review-required.
Transaction type 0 is purchase/capture; no end-to-end purchase assertion is executed here.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: No network routing BR.
Clause findings: No mapped Mastercard network-routing oracle or observed issuer route.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: Authorization transaction type recognised; no 'all mandatory elements present' BR for the request.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: Decline-code interpretation only; no response-format BR.
Clause findings: Appendix H decline interpretation is not response reception, complete message-format validation or transport evidence.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: Template cites Element 6; ATL105 Approval Number is Element 5.
Clause findings: Approval Number is Element 5. Element 6 is Approved Amount. Existing candidate checks required approval-reference presence, not capture/storage.

scenarios.Existing map caveat: Reuse in lifecycle follow-ups; settlement use not covered.
Clause findings: Follow-up approval/sequence reuse is represented; durable storage and settlement availability are not proven.
Response-code 0 purchase and code 2 authorization fixtures exist. They do not prove that a host sale was completed.
Declined response plus DeclineCode fixture exists; no live sale-rejection observation is claimed.
